record.question: Who among the following used the term computer worm for the first time?
record.explanation: The intended literary-origin answer is John Brunner, whose1975 novel The Shockwave Rider describes a network tapeworm. Shoch and Hupp’s original1982 worm-program paper explicitly introduces the idea through Brunner’s novel. Precision note: Brunner’s fictional origin is distinct from Shoch/Hupp’s technical worm-program work; this does not claim Brunner implemented the first working network worm. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~prabal/resources/osprelim/SH82.pdf
